definition: Money transferred with no expectation of repayment — donations, prizes, non-reimbursable assistance.
A loan on terms softer than the market would give: below-market interest, long maturity, a grace period, or a service charge in place of interest. IDA credits belong here.
A loan on market terms — syndicated and senior debt, IBRD lending, development-policy loans to non-IDA borrowers.
A facility the borrower draws against up to a limit, revolving or not.
Finance extended to the buyer so it may pay the supplier, including export finance.
Debt raised by issuing a tradeable security.
A commitment to meet another party's obligation if it defaults. No money moves unless it is called.
Money exchanged for an ownership stake, at any round from pre-seed to acquisition, including limited-partner commitments to a fund.
Subordinated debt, or debt convertible to equity, ranking between senior debt and equity.
A jointly owned vehicle created by the parties to carry the activity.
A concession, BOT or similar: a private party finances and operates a public asset for a term. Distinct from the PPP value in the beneficiary vocabulary.
Capital the recipient commits from its own balance sheet. A funding source rather than an instrument, kept because the distinction is worth counting.
Expertise, advisory or capacity support, whether or not a cash figure is attached.
An agreement is on record and its financial instrument is not. Use only where the source states an agreement and does not state how the money moves — never as shorthand for unclear.
The source does not state the instrument.
Proposed, identified or under negotiation. Nothing is committed.
Committed, approved or signed, but not yet operating.
Operating: implementation under way, facility inaugurated, activities launched, funds disbursing.
Finished or fully disbursed, and IATI's finalisation stage where financial closure is outstanding.
Abandoned before completion. IATI activity-status 5.
Halted, to resume or be decided. IATI activity-status 6.
The source does not state the status.
Government at any level — a ministry, agency, programme or state-owned enterprise.
A company, operator, startup or bank receiving on its own account.
A non-governmental or civil-society organisation, including not-for-profit membership and industry associations.
A multilateral, regional or continental body — the AU, a regional economic community, an intergovernmental organisation.
A university, research institute or think tank.
An investment vehicle that will on-invest the money. One step removed from the ultimate recipient, which is why it is not Private Sector.
Several types together, where no one of them is the beneficiary. A genuine consortium or partnership, not a failure to classify.
People rather than organisations — students, entrepreneurs, households.
A public-private vehicle receiving as one party. Distinct from the PPP value in the instrument vocabulary.
The source does not state who receives.
